evidence.quote: self.body = render_body(PROBLEM_BASE + suffix, title, status, detail, retryable, ext)
2d. deliberate breakage: a capability's own registry gate builds its own body by hand instead of calling render_body

evidence.command:
python3 -c "
import ast,glob,re
d=open('docs/decomposition.md').read().replace(chr(96),'')
pub=set(re.findall(r'\|\s([a-z0-9-]+)\s\|\s\d{3}\s\|',d))
s=set()
for f in glob.glob('harness/*/interface.py'):
    for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(open(f).read())):
        t=n.targets[0] if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and n.targets else getattr(n,'target',None)
        if isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id in ('REGISTRY','PROBLEM_REGISTRY') and isinstance(n.value,ast.Dict):
            s.update(k.value for k in n.value.keys if isinstance(k,ast.Constant))
print('published_rows=%d harness_registry_suffixes=%d with_no_published_row=%d'%(len(pub),len(s),len(s-pub)))
"

finding: aligned_looks_like now holds mechanically and platform-wide, not just inside one capability tree: render_body() in harness/errors/problem.py is "The one function anywhere under harness/ that assembles the RFC 9457 wire" dict, 26 capability interfaces import it rather than building a body (the composition layer that previously built its own now renders through it: "self.body = render_body(PROBLEM_BASE + suffix, title, status, detail, retryable, ext)"), each keeping only its own typed condition class and closed registry -- exactly "adapters raise typed conditions that the shared construction point renders". Two independent gates prove there is no second place a body is built: a static scan over every .py file under harness/ reports platform_stray_construction_hits=0, and the dynamic companion loads every harness, raises every registry row and confirms the shared render counter rose by exactly that many (conditions_raised=121 harnesses_covered=27 render_count=121), with a deliberate breakage that re-hand-builds one adapter's body failing both (passed 37, failed 0). It is aligned and not leading because only the wire shape is centrally owned, not the type vocabulary: 39 suffixes live in 27 private registries and 29 of them have no row in the published registry, including xc-tenancy's locally minted "budget-exceeded": (403, ...) sitting beside the published | `budget-exhausted` | 402 | -- so a new adapter can no longer invent a failure shape, but can still invent a failure type.
